blockingIssues.description: Billboard detection heuristic in draw_helpers.rs:111-114 uses mesh.has_attribute(TexCoord0) to identify billboard draws, but ALL PBR meshes (regular scene meshes, cubes, spheres, planes from glTF) also have TexCoord0 since create_pbr_mesh/create_pbr_mesh_with_tangents always add it. Since the full draw_list (including all scene meshes) is submitted to the depth prepass, all non-skinned PBR meshes would be incorrectly routed to the billboard depth pipeline which uses camera-facing vertex transforms instead of standard MVP transforms. This produces incorrect depth values, breaking early-Z rejection and GPU entity picking for all non-skinned scene objects.
blockingIssues.suggestedFix: Add a boolean flag (e.g., is_billboard: bool) to the DrawCall struct in katla_gfx, set by the katla_app caller in collect_billboard_draw_calls(). Then check this flag in draw_helpers.rs instead of inferring from vertex attributes. This avoids the cross-crate dependency issue (katla_gfx cannot access billboard_resources.material from katla_app) and follows the existing pattern for skinned meshes which uses draw_call.skeleton.

nonBlockingIssues.description: The billboard detection approach uses vertex attribute inspection in katla_gfx, but the caller (katla_app) already knows which entities are billboards. A DrawCall-level flag would be cleaner and more reliable.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add guidance: when adding specialized draw types (billboard, decal, etc.) that need different pipeline routing in the render graph, always use a DrawCall-level flag rather than inferring draw type from mesh attributes. The katla_gfx crate cannot depend on katla_app to inspect application-level state, so the caller must communicate draw type explicitly.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Feature integrate-billboard-depth-prepass used mesh.has_attribute(TexCoord0) to detect billboards, but all PBR meshes have TexCoord0. This caused a blocking correctness bug where all non-skinned scene meshes were routed through the billboard pipeline.

rejectedObservations.observation: material_params.w is commented as 'emission_idx' in frame_uniforms.wgsl but billboard shaders repurpose it as albedo texture index
rejectedObservations.reason: This is an existing convention for billboard-specific rendering where texture_indices is unused. Not specific to this milestone — would be a separate documentation improvement.
